The plot illustrates the relationship between the number of models and Spearman’s R correlation. The x-axis is labeled “Number of models *M* (log)” and has a logarithmic scale ranging from 25 to 500, with tick labels at 25, 50, 100, 250 and 500. The y-axis is labeled “Spearman’s R correlation *r*(Xt ⇒ Xt)” and has a linear scale ranging from 0.90 to 1.00, with tick labels at 0.92, 0.94, 0.96, 0.98, and 1.00. A single blue solid line is present, starting at approximately (25, 0.95) and increasing to approximately (500, 0.99).  Between these points, the line rises with increasing x values, passing through a point around (50, 0.96) and (100, 0.98).
